comment: Golden vectors for reading the health export's status while runtimes adopt runtime-health/v4. Each case is items[0] of a verified health export response, requested_device_id, the device the export was requested from, and whether the gateway has read a marked item from it before. Legacy items are mutations of the producer exports in health-transition-baselines-v2.json. A gateway must read each case as the severity given, and hold or not hold the device's latch afterwards as given.
